buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) The bidder should be comply as per buyer uploded scope of work document a nd the following conditions otherwise firm offer will be rejected.: 1.SERVICE DESCRIPTION: Railway Electrification Secunderabad projec t invites open tender through the GeM portal from eligible agencies f or General Maintenance and Up-keeping of the CPD/RE/SC Office at S ecunderabad and Rest House at Mettuguda and RE stores office at LG D for a period of twelve (12) Months. 2. Firm should have valid Labour License Certificate from Telangana State Government only and should be submitted along with offer bid. 3. Firm office/ Branches address should be in Secunderabad/ Hyderab ad/ Telangana State and documentary proof such as Rental Agreeme nt/ Electricity Bill or any Government issued document should be uplo

aded at GeM.gov.in, otherwise offer will be rejected. 4.Firm should have 03 years annual turnover certificate and should b e submitted with certified Chartered accountant along with offer bid. 5. Asper GCC of Service contract 2018 : T1- Annual Turnover : The bid der shall have annual financial turnover not less than 1.5 times the a dvertised bid value during the last 3 previous financial years and in t he current financial year up to the date of opening of the tender. The audited balance sheet reflecting financial turnover certified by accou ntant with stamp signature and membership number shall be conside red and should be submitted the same. 6.Firm should be registered in Shramik Kalyan Portal. 7. Bidder financial standing ,non-banning, truthfulness of Document s etc and other Declaration : The bidders shall upload an undertaking (a) certifying the truthfulness of all the documents submitted/upload ed along with the tender .[Proforma as per Annexure-I of Buyer uploa ded ATC document](b) Declaration of the details of the engagement of Retire d/Existing Railway Employees; Regarding site visit,complian ce of statutory laws, penalty for violation of labor laws,Non blacklisti ng,bankruptcy , termination of contracts etc.[Proforma as per Annex ure-II of Buyer uploaded ATC document]The format /performa etc is u ploaded in the Buyer uploaded ATC document in the bid document .Bi dders are requested to click the link and download from the bid. 8.Security Deposit: Security Deposit should be 5% of the contract val ue shall be recovered from running bill @10% till it reaches the 5% of the contract value. The Security Deposit shall be returned to the cont ractor after expiry of the maintenance/warranty/guarantee period wh ichever is later and after paying the final bill based on the “No Claim Certificate” submitted by the firm. 9. PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE: Performance Guarantee at a rate of 5 % of the contractual value shall be deposited by the successful bidde r. to be submit in favour of FA&CAO/SCR/SC. The successful bidder sh all have to submit a performance Guarantee (FDR) valuing 5% of the contract value in the form of fixed deposit receipt, within 30 (Thirty) days of issue of Letter of Acceptance (LOA) if Firm/agency would faile d to submit PG, 15% per annum shall be charged beyond 30 days. In c ase the firm/agency fails to submit the requisite PG even after 90 day s. From the date of issue of LOA, the contract shall be terminated dul y forfeiting EMD and other dues if any, the failed contractor shall be debarred from participating in re-tender for that work. 10. The Bill Passing officer is CEE/RE/SC and the Bill Paying Officer is AFA/Exp/SCR/SC. 11. Tax Invoice to be raised in the name of consignee and according to the service delivered state GSTIN: 36AAAGM0289C1ZK.

12. Firm must be followed as per the chief labour commission prescri bed wages. Rebate on the minimum wages and non-payment of the E SI,EPF for the deployed staff shall be viewed seriously anything notic ed irregularities for these conditions contract will be terminated and subsequently collected security deposit and bank guarantee should b e forfeited. Moreover, the firm shall be blacklisted and debarred from participating in any Railway tenders in future. 13. "The firm must be registered on the ESI and EPF portals. Relevan t registration documents must be uploaded along with the bid offer. Failure to upload these documents will result in the rejection of the b id. 14.Good conduct certificate to be submitted before deployment. in favour of one outsourced attendant at RE/Rest house at Mettuguda from his local police stati n. 15. This is purely an outsourcing activity and not an offer of job in railways to b e the personnel deployed by the agency. No claims of any sort in this regard ar e entertained. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 5. Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 100% of total value. 6. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 7. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
